notes: Tone and rules: research.md §5–8. 'league' marks tips with a League reference (target: about half). 'minutes' must be 27 or less. Tips of the day stop showing after 'expires' (inclusive, local date).

tips.title: Climb stairs for 10 minutes.
tips.text: The only climb where you can't get hardstuck.

tips.title: Do 20 push-ups.
tips.text: Count out loud. Your neighbors deserve to know you're improving.

tips.title: Hold a plank for one minute.
tips.text: Longest minute of your life. Somehow longer than waiting for ff15.

tips.title: Go for a 20-minute run.
tips.text: Bring headphones. Come back a slightly better person.

tips.title: Stretch for 10 minutes.
tips.text: Your back has been in champ select posture for hours.

tips.title: Do 50 jumping jacks.
tips.text: Your downstairs neighbor will have questions.

tips.title: Shoot hoops for 20 minutes.
tips.text: Practice your last-hitting. On a basket, for once.

tips.title: Follow a 15-minute yoga video.
tips.text: Breathe in, breathe out. Your shoulders don't need to live at your ears.

tips.title: Bike around the neighborhood.
tips.text: 20 minutes of real map movement. Wards not included.

tips.title: Jump rope for 5 minutes.
tips.text: Feels easy for 30 seconds. Then it really doesn't.

tips.title: Squat through one whole song.
tips.text: As many squats as the song is long. Leg day speedrun.

tips.title: Do a 7-minute workout.
tips.text: Shorter than champ select with a dodge in it.

tips.title: Kick a ball against a wall.
tips.text: Ten minutes of pure footwork. The wall never flames back.

tips.title: Dance to three songs.
tips.text: Nobody's watching. Unless you stream it. Please don't stream it.

tips.title: Walk 2,000 steps.
tips.text: About 20 minutes. Your step counter finally gets something to report.

tips.title: Do a two-minute wall sit.
tips.text: Like getting autofilled support, but for your thighs.

tips.title: Shadowbox for three rounds.
tips.text: Get the tilt out of your system, one jab at a time.

tips.title: Lunge from room to room.
tips.text: The kitchen is now a destination. Earn your snack.

tips.title: Try a handstand against a wall.
tips.text: You'll fail a few times. Comfortable territory, honestly.

tips.title: Roll your wrists and shoulders.
tips.text: Ten slow circles each way. Your mouse hand earned this.

tips.title: Watch one episode.
tips.text: About as long as a game. Nobody types "jg diff" at you.

tips.title: Watch one anime episode.
tips.text: 24 minutes, including the opening. Don't skip the opening.

tips.title: Rewatch a favorite sitcom episode.
tips.text: You know every joke. They still land. Comfort food for your eyes.

tips.title: Watch a short film.
tips.text: Under 20 minutes, full story, and it actually ends. Unlike "one more game".

tips.title: Watch a pro match highlight reel.
tips.text: See what clean play looks like. Zero risk to your own rank.

tips.title: Watch a cooking show episode.
tips.text: Watch someone else panic over a timer for 20 minutes. Soothing.

tips.title: Watch a short documentary.
tips.text: Learn one weird fact. Use it to win the group chat.

tips.title: Binge five movie trailers.
tips.text: All the hype, none of the queue timer.

tips.title: Start a series with the pilot.
tips.text: Pilots are a free trial. No rank decay if you quit.

tips.title: Watch a nature doc segment.
tips.text: Wolves hunting with perfect teamwork. Your team could never.

tips.title: Watch 20 minutes of stand-up.
tips.text: Someone roasting people professionally, and everyone's laughing.

tips.title: Rewatch your favorite movie scene.
tips.text: You know the one. Goosebumps guaranteed.

tips.title: Watch a cartoon from childhood.
tips.text: 11 minutes of nostalgia. Back when your only rank was "kid".

tips.title: Watch a foreign-language episode.
tips.text: Subtitles on. Technically you're learning a language now.

tips.title: Let a friend pick an episode.
tips.text: Their taste, your evening. Trust the shotcaller for once.

tips.title: Watch one video essay.
tips.text: 25 minutes on something oddly specific. You'll have opinions about lighthouses now.

tips.title: Watch a sitcom with a snack.
tips.text: Episode plus snack. A perfect bot lane.

tips.title: Finish the movie you dozed through.
tips.text: Find out how it ended. Closure feels good.

tips.title: Watch a speedrun video.
tips.text: Someone beats a whole game in 18 minutes. Your games last longer than that.

tips.title: Build a weekend watchlist.
tips.text: 15 minutes of picking. Saturday you will be grateful.

tips.title: Read 30 pages.
tips.text: No autofill. You pick the role, the book and the pace.

tips.title: Read one short story.
tips.text: Beginning, middle, end, one sitting. Shorter than your promos, happier ending.

tips.title: Read a comic chapter.
tips.text: Pictures count as reading. Don't let anyone tell you otherwise.

tips.title: Read that saved article.
tips.text: The one you bookmarked three months ago. It's still waiting.

tips.title: Read a poem out loud.
tips.text: Feels silly for ten seconds. Then it sounds kind of great.

tips.title: One chapter, phone in another room.
tips.text: Your phone will survive. So will your notifications.

tips.title: Fall down a Wikipedia rabbit hole.
tips.text: Start at pancakes. End at medieval siege engines. Guaranteed.

tips.title: Read a manga chapter.
tips.text: The main character also had a losing streak. Look how that turned out.

tips.title: Read a classic's first chapter.
tips.text: Just one. If it's boring, ff15 it. No shame.

tips.title: Listen to an audiobook chapter.
tips.text: Eyes closed still counts. Reading on easy mode.

tips.title: Read outside your usual genre.
tips.text: Off-role reading. Worst case, you learn something.

tips.title: Read about a city you'd visit.
tips.text: Plan a trip you might take. Map awareness, real-life edition.

tips.title: Reread your favorite chapter.
tips.text: Like rewatching your best play, except this one definitely happened.

tips.title: Read a newsletter you subscribed to.
tips.text: You subscribed for a reason. Find out what it was.

tips.title: Read 10 pages of non-fiction.
tips.text: One new fact per page. Free brain upgrades.

tips.title: Read to someone.
tips.text: Kid, partner, cat. The cat won't follow the plot. Doesn't matter.

tips.title: Read in a new spot.
tips.text: Balcony, bathtub, floor. New lane, same book.

tips.title: Read the book behind a movie.
tips.text: One chapter. Then say "the book was better" with authority.

tips.title: Read until your tea gets cold.
tips.text: Make tea, open a book, stop when it's cold. About 20 minutes.

tips.title: Pick your next book.
tips.text: Read three first pages, pick one. Draft phase, but for books.

tips.title: Go for a walk.
tips.text: 27 minutes, same as a game, zero LP lost.

tips.title: Walk around the block twice.
tips.text: Tilted? This is /mute all for the whole world.

tips.title: Sit outside for 10 minutes.
tips.text: No phone. Just you and whatever the weather is doing.

tips.title: Find the nearest park bench.
tips.text: Sit. Watch dogs. Rank the dogs. Every dog is Challenger.

tips.title: Catch the sunset.
tips.text: Check when the sun sets. Be outside for it. Free cinematic.

tips.title: Walk to buy one small thing.
tips.text: A snack, a stamp, a lemon. Purpose achieved.

tips.title: Go stargazing for 15 minutes.
tips.text: Find one constellation. Or make one up. Nobody checks.

tips.title: Photograph five interesting things.
tips.text: Your camera roll is all scoreboard screenshots. Fix that.

tips.title: Walk without headphones.
tips.text: Just street sounds. Weirdly calm. Your brain will take it.

tips.title: Explore a street you've never walked.
tips.text: Your fog of war is bigger than you think.

tips.title: Walk to the nearest water.
tips.text: River, lake, fountain. Stare at it. Water has no win rate.

tips.title: Get ten minutes of sunlight.
tips.text: Your face has been lit by the client for weeks.

tips.title: Walk it off after a loss.
tips.text: To the corner and back. Recall to base, literally.

tips.title: Eat your next meal outside.
tips.text: Same food. Better view. Birds included.

tips.title: Walk a dog.
tips.text: Yours or a neighbor's. The dog sets the pace. You just follow.

tips.title: Take out the trash, keep walking.
tips.text: You were going outside anyway. Add ten minutes.

tips.title: Have a drink on the balcony.
tips.text: Tea, juice, whatever. Look at the actual sky.

tips.title: Do a mini scavenger hunt.
tips.text: Find a feather, a weird rock and a red leaf. Quest complete.

tips.title: Go cloud watching.
tips.text: Lie down, look up, name the clouds. One of them looks like your jungler.

tips.title: Take a night walk.
tips.text: Quiet streets, cold air. Night mode, but outside.

tips.title: Make pancakes.
tips.text: You farm minions all day. Farm some pancakes instead.

tips.title: Cook one perfect egg.
tips.text: Pick one style and master it. A one-trick, but breakfast.

tips.title: Make a real sandwich.
tips.text: Not the one you eat over the keyboard. A sit-down sandwich.

tips.title: Cut fruit into a nice bowl.
tips.text: Takes 10 minutes. Feels like you have your life together.

tips.title: Make tea the slow way.
tips.text: Loose leaf, timer, proper mug. Patience is a skill. Ask any support main.

tips.title: Upgrade your instant ramen.
tips.text: Add an egg, green onions, chili. Full build, not starter items.

tips.title: Bake cookies from a mix.
tips.text: 12 minutes in the oven. Your place will smell incredible.

tips.title: Blend a smoothie.
tips.text: Banana plus whatever's in the fridge. Surprisingly hard to mess up.

tips.title: Cook a dish from another country.
tips.text: One you've never made. New patch, new meta.

tips.title: Make a proper hot chocolate.
tips.text: Real milk, real chocolate. The heal you actually needed.

tips.title: Cook from fridge leftovers.
tips.text: Three random ingredients, one dinner. Like ARAM, but edible.

tips.title: Make guacamole.
tips.text: Mash, squeeze, salt, done. A snack worth sharing.

tips.title: Prep tomorrow's breakfast.
tips.text: Overnight oats. Tomorrow starts with a win, guaranteed.

tips.title: Pop popcorn on the stove.
tips.text: Pan, oil, kernels, lid. Very loud, very satisfying.

tips.title: Cook dinner for someone.
tips.text: Someone in your home is about to be very surprised.

tips.title: Make a grilled cheese.
tips.text: Low heat, golden crust. Don't rush it. Don't int it.

tips.title: Learn one knife trick.
tips.text: Five-minute video, one onion, practice. Crying optional.

tips.title: Squeeze fresh lemonade.
tips.text: Lemons, sugar, water, ice. Life gave you lemons? Fine, then.

tips.title: Bake a mug cake.
tips.text: Microwave, five minutes. Faster than a peak-hour loading screen.

tips.title: Plan three dinners this week.
tips.text: 15 minutes now saves you from 2am cereal later.

tips.title: Go to bed now.
tips.text: Your LP will still be there tomorrow. So will the Rift.

tips.title: Put your phone across the room.
tips.text: Out of reach, out of mind. Then lie down.

tips.title: Take a 20-minute nap.
tips.text: Sleep is the biggest buff in the game. And it's free.

tips.title: Take a hot shower.
tips.text: Washes off the tilt and the pizza crumbs.

tips.title: Dim every light in the room.
tips.text: Your brain thinks it's noon. Tell it the truth.

tips.title: Do a slow wind-down stretch.
tips.text: On the floor, lights low. Your body will take the hint.

tips.title: Set a bedtime alarm tonight.
tips.text: An alarm that says "sleep" beats a promise that says "last game".

tips.title: Put fresh sheets on.
tips.text: Fresh sheets feel like a new skin. And they're free.

tips.title: Write tomorrow's to-do list.
tips.text: Empty your head onto paper. Then sleep with an empty head.

tips.title: Drink a glass of water.
tips.text: After three energy drinks, your body would love some actual water.

tips.title: Listen to a sleep story.
tips.text: A calm voice describes a train ride. You're out by the second station.

tips.title: Close the client. Fully.
tips.text: Not minimized. Closed. The X in the corner.

tips.title: Try 4-7-8 breathing.
tips.text: In for 4, hold for 7, out for 8. Your cooldowns reset too.

tips.title: Read something boring in bed.
tips.text: Terms of service, an old manual. Works every single time.

tips.title: Skip the 2am game.
tips.text: You won't end on a win. You'll end at 4am.

tips.title: Call it after two losses.
tips.text: Two in a row is the stop rule. Your bed has no losing streak.

tips.title: Put on socks, get in bed.
tips.text: Warm feet, faster sleep. That's science. Sort of.

tips.title: Air out your room.
tips.text: Window open for 10 minutes. Your room smells like ranked.

tips.title: Set an alarm before noon.
tips.text: Tomorrow, you get daylight. Remember daylight?

tips.title: Lie down with an eye mask.
tips.text: Room dark, eyes covered. Vision denied, on purpose this time.

tips.title: Listen to one full album.
tips.text: No skipping. Side A alone is about 20 minutes.

tips.title: Make a wake-up playlist.
tips.text: Ten songs for tomorrow morning. Better than the queue pop sound.

tips.title: Learn one chorus by heart.
tips.text: Lyrics on screen, song on repeat. Concert-ready by midnight.

tips.title: Play your instrument for 20 minutes.
tips.text: The guitar in the corner has been waiting. Dust it off.

tips.title: Sing in the shower.
tips.text: Great acoustics, zero audience. The only voice comms you need.

tips.title: Play one song per decade.
tips.text: 1960s to now. Time travel in 25 minutes.

tips.title: Find a tiny artist.
tips.text: Under 1,000 monthly listeners. Become their biggest fan tonight.

tips.title: Listen with your eyes closed.
tips.text: Lie on the floor, headphones on. Just listen. That's it.

tips.title: Replay the songs from your teens.
tips.text: Instant nostalgia. Back when everything felt brand new.

tips.title: Build a tilt-proof playlist.
tips.text: Ten calm songs for after a loss. Press play instead of "Find Match".

tips.title: Learn one guitar riff.
tips.text: Five-minute tutorial, then repeat until it sounds right.

tips.title: Put on lo-fi, do nothing.
tips.text: No tasks. Just vibes. The rare nothing that feels earned.

tips.title: Trade songs with a friend.
tips.text: Send one track, ask for one back. A trade where nobody gets robbed.

tips.title: Tier-list your favorite songs.
tips.text: Your S-tier pick will surprise you.

tips.title: Listen to a live album.
tips.text: Crowd noise, tiny mistakes, real energy. Beats the studio version.

tips.title: Clean one room to a playlist.
tips.text: One playlist, one room. Shorter than a game, and you actually win.

tips.title: Play a 20-minute classical piece.
tips.text: Epic boss music. Baron spawn energy, but older.

tips.title: Build a duo playlist.
tips.text: You add one, they add one. A duo queue that actually communicates.

tips.title: Play music on real speakers.
tips.text: Fill the room. Louder than your teammate breathing into the mic.

tips.title: Identify the song in your head.
tips.text: Hum it into a search app. Mystery solved in two minutes.

tips.title: Counter their invite with pizza.
tips.text: They text "queue up?" You reply "pizza?" Same squad, no lane fights.

tips.title: Call a friend instead of texting.
tips.text: Actual voices. No pings, no "?" spam.

tips.title: Take a walk with your duo.
tips.text: Same duo, new map. The only objective is coffee.

tips.title: Board game night with the squad.
tips.text: Still competitive. But nobody can accuse the dice of inting.

tips.title: Voice-message an old friend.
tips.text: The one you haven't talked to in a year. Just say hi.

tips.title: Cook something with friends.
tips.text: Everyone brings one ingredient. Team comp, but dinner.

tips.title: Co-watch an episode on a call.
tips.text: Hit play at the same time. React live. Co-op mode.

tips.title: Plan a real-life meetup.
tips.text: You've played together for years. Pick a date. Meet their actual face.

tips.title: Grab a coffee with someone nearby.
tips.text: 20 minutes, one coffee, zero headsets.

tips.title: Card game night with the squad.
tips.text: Uno ends friendships faster than ranked. Try it anyway.

tips.title: Text three friends something nice.
tips.text: No reason. Just "you're great". Watch them get suspicious.

tips.title: Video call with no game open.
tips.text: Just faces. Weird for a minute. Then really good.

tips.title: Do a puzzle with whoever's home.
tips.text: 1,000 pieces is too many. 300 is perfect teamwork.

tips.title: Help a friend with something.
tips.text: Moving a couch, fixing a bike. Real support, real peel.

tips.title: Bowl one game with the squad.
tips.text: Gutter balls are funny, not reportable.

tips.title: Start a group chat photo round.
tips.text: Everyone sends a photo of their view right now. Go.

tips.title: Host a quiz night online.
tips.text: Five rounds of trivia. Someone will still blame lag.

tips.title: Visit a friend who lives close.
tips.text: Knock on an actual door. They'll be shocked.

tips.title: Make weekend plans now.
tips.text: A Saturday with a plan beats a Saturday on autopilot.

tips.title: Introduce two friends to each other.
tips.text: Finally, matchmaking you're actually good at.

tipsOfTheDay.title: Swiss Stage is for watching.
tipsOfTheDay.text: Pull up a match with friends. Way better than soloqueueing through it.
tipsOfTheDay.fact: Worlds 2026 Swiss Stage, Oct 23–31, Allen, Texas.

tipsOfTheDay.title: Nobody's Swiss record depends on you.
tipsOfTheDay.text: Teams in Texas are playing for their lives. You can just play nothing.
tipsOfTheDay.fact: Swiss Stage: teams advance at 3 wins, go home at 3 losses.

tipsOfTheDay.title: Even pros have rough openers.
tipsOfTheDay.text: All four LPL teams lost on day one. Logging off after one loss is fine.

tipsOfTheDay.title: Worlds is for watching, not queueing.
tipsOfTheDay.text: Nobody will remember your 2am game. Everyone remembers the final.

tipsOfTheDay.title: T1 is chasing title number four.
tipsOfTheDay.text: Four in a row. Your ranked game tonight won't change how it ends.

tipsOfTheDay.title: Quarterfinals start November 3.
tipsOfTheDay.text: Best-of-fives run long. Snacks ready, client closed.

tipsOfTheDay.title: It's semifinal weekend.
tipsOfTheDay.text: Two days of the best League on the planet. Watch it, don't grind it.

tipsOfTheDay.title: Plan a watch party for the final.
tipsOfTheDay.text: First Worlds final on the East Coast. Friends, snacks, zero LP at stake.

tipsOfTheDay.title: Final day. Queue can wait.
tipsOfTheDay.text: Nobody soloqueues through a Worlds final. Not even you.

tipsOfTheDay.title: The True Damage skins aren't leaving.
tipsOfTheDay.text: Know My Name will still know your name tomorrow.
tipsOfTheDay.fact: Patch 26.21 (Oct 21): True Damage Know My Name skins.

tipsOfTheDay.title: Prestige Ekko can wait.
tipsOfTheDay.text: He rewinds time. You can't. Get some sleep.
tipsOfTheDay.fact: Prestige True Damage Know My Name Ekko, patch 26.21.

tipsOfTheDay.title: Journey to Stardom runs until January.
tipsOfTheDay.text: Your missions can survive a night off. Easily.
tipsOfTheDay.fact: ARAM: Mayhem Journey to Stardom progress ends Jan 27, 2027 (Riot Support).

tipsOfTheDay.title: The Headliners aren't going on tour.
tipsOfTheDay.text: ARAM: Mayhem's bands play again tomorrow. Tonight, pick your own music.
tipsOfTheDay.fact: Patch 26.21 added band-themed Headliners to ARAM: Mayhem.

tipsOfTheDay.title: Patch 26.22 lands November 4.
tipsOfTheDay.text: Whatever gets nerfed, you'll learn it faster after a night off.

tipsOfTheDay.title: Ranked isn't ending this week.
tipsOfTheDay.text: Plenty of season left. Tonight can go to something else.
tipsOfTheDay.fact: Ranked Season 3 is expected to end in early January 2027 (not yet confirmed).
